svg.title: Airflow Data Quality Gate — Poridhi Lab 5.6
svg.desc: Airflow DAG poridhi_ge_training: prepare_data writes run-scoped training.csv and shares its path via XCom with quality_gate. quality_gate runs a Great Expectations suite and checkpoint, and train_model runs only after PASS, saving model.json. All six original connectors and components are preserved.

g.text: Learn data engineering by building it
